title: Bathroom Visit Frequency Change Guard
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bathroom:visit
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits by _time
| eventstats avg(visits) as base stdev(visits) as sd
| eval unusual=if(visits>base+(2*sd) OR visits<base-(2*sd),1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Flags days where bathroom frequency changes sharply from your normal baseline.
value: A change in frequency is often more revealing than the absolute number because it reflects your usual pattern.
implementation: Send bathroom visits to `index=personal`; compare daily totals with baseline and alert on sudden shifts.
visualization: Daily chart of visit counts with anomaly markers.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights when bathroom visits change a lot from your normal pattern, which is usually more important than any one day alone.
